stem: What is the most likely reason the author uses a metaphor in this sentence?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 8 of the article from Competitive Cheerleading.

Cheering for just a few judges—that takes steel nerves.

options.label: A
options.text: To emphasize that cheerleaders prefer performing in front of small groups

options.label: B
options.text: To highlight the determination that cheerleaders need during a performance

options.label: C
options.text: To describe the features judges look for when cheerleaders perform

options.label: D
options.text: To suggest that cheerleaders are eager to receive performance feedback

visual_elements: Cheering for just a few judges—that takes steel nerves.
